evidence.note: Verified `node --test templates/mutation-incremental/test/*.test.mjs` with MUTATION_ALLOW_TMP_STATE unset in the environment: 142/142 tests pass (previously failed on loadConfig's tmp-dir guard).
alias specifier that resolves to no file falls through to isInstalledPackage before being counted unresolved, matching plan note re: '@' aliasing '@testing-library/react'
test 'an alias key that prefixes a scoped package name...' exercises the fallthrough and asserts the package is not an open importer

findings.note: Bare `node --test` on this shard's test files failed without MUTATION_ALLOW_TMP_STATE=1, because loadConfig (lib/config.mjs:99-103, now :193-197 in this diff) refuses repos under the OS temp dir where test-created repos live. Fixed in commit 72169b5 by defaulting the env var in test/helpers.mjs for test-created repos; the Go CI wrapper already set it independently. Re-ran the full suite with the variable unset: 142/142 pass. The guard itself (spec S4: state must never live under a purged temp dir) is intended behavior, not a bug.
